content.title: 1-1: Valverde secures Uruguay's draw against England in added time
content.text: Uruguay and England drew in the friendly match held at Wembley Stadium. After a goalless first half, the English team took the lead with a goal from White. However, in the final moments of the match, Valverde scored the 1-1 with a powerful penalty shot. The midfielder started the game. Bellingham, on the other hand, was not included in his national team's squad for this match. Disclaimer: Translation generated by artificial intelligence. It may contain inaccuracies.
